thread:
maria: quick heads up — partner webhook logs in staging include what looks like a GCS object containing a service account key blob. I think it was uploaded as a backup artifact. not yet in prod but we should treat as compromised and rotate/contain.

jamal: can you paste the exact log line or object path? want to scope which SA and project.

maria: gist of the line: `gs://partner-backups/staging/2026-03-23/backup-az3f.json.gz` contains `{"type":"service_account","private_key_id":"...","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----..."}` — the file is KMS-wrapped ciphertext (looks like a wrapped blob) but we can still extract SA id from the file metadata: `redwood-staging-backup-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

aj: ok good find. if it's KMS-wrapped ciphertext then immediate steps: 1) identify KMS key + project that wrapped it 2) check who had decrypt/unwrap perms 3) rotate the SA keys and revoke bindings. any idea which KMS key?

maria: metadata shows `projects/partner-project/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/wrap-2025` — partner-managed key. they used it to wrap the backup blob.

sec-bot: detection alert: sensitive_artifact_upload — file matched SA key regex; severity medium; detected 2026-03-23T15:40:12Z; file size 42KB.

ops-oncall: tagging for incident (SOM-2026-119). starting containment checklist: - lock object read perms - snapshot blob for forensics - request KMS audit logs from partner - start SA rotation in staging.

lina: @maria can you confirm whether any service principals used that SA (deploy jobs, CI, etc)? need immediate token revocation if used.

maria: quick grep across CI and deployed envs: two references in staging terraform state and one CI job: `ci/staging-snapshot` (only staging). No production references found.

jamal: plan proposal: 1) create incident ticket (ops-oncall taking) 2) ask partner to provide KMS audit logs and who had unwrap IAM binding (we need the member list) 3) rotate the SA (create new SA, update runtime perms, revoke old key) 4) invalidate any tokens / short-lived creds tied to that SA 5) run a repo/artifact scan for similar leaks 6) schedule cross-account RBAC review if partner has long-lived unwrap grants.

aj: note on step 3 — since the blob is KMS-wrapped by partner key, rotating the KMS key won't re-encrypt anything we don't control. we should focus on the SA rotation and assume the wrapped blob could be unwrapped by any principal with UnwrapPermission on partner key. ask partner to rotate their wrap key and audit.

maria: I pinged partner security (cc: @partner-sec) and requested temporary removal of any broad `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` grants until they can audit. asked for logs 1) who used `projects.partner-project.locations.keyRings.backups.cryptoKeys.wrap-2025:decrypt` 2) when.

sec-bot: reminder: record all communications in SOM-2026-119 incident channel and attach the file snapshot to evidence bucket (read-only).

ops-oncall: assigned tasks: - ops-oncall: create incident ticket + attach snapshot (in progress) - jamal: prepare SA rotation script + tf changes (ETA 2h) - aj: prepare KMS audit request wording + least-priv rollback plan (ETA 1h) - maria: run scan across artifacts and mark other potential exposures (ETA 30m) - lina: coordinate CI token invalidation and redeploy jobs (ETA 45m).

lina: quick snippet for CI invalidation: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-staging-backup-sa@...` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID` and redeploy `ci/staging-snapshot` with new SA creds.

jamal: putting rotation checklist in the ticket. also adding env var sweep: `rg "redwood-staging-backup-sa" -S` across infra repos.

maria: small gotcha: terraform state references will need state migration — I'll put a tfstate patch in the ticket so infra changes can be rolled out safely.

aj: couple of audit questions for partner ask: - provide KMS Cloud Audit Logs for the last 90 days for that cryptoKey - list principals with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` and `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on that key - confirm whether any external principals or service accounts were granted via groups.

partner-sec: received, will start log pull and IAM listing. we will block wide-decrypt grants temporarily and share results within 2 hours.

ops-oncall: we're treating this as contained for now (staging only). next steps after partner confirms: rotate SA keys, update CI, rotate partner wrap key if they had broad unwrap grants, and do post-incident RBAC hardening.

lina: can we add an audit log sink for partner KMS decrypt events into our central SIEM for cross-account alerts? if partner can grant a log-export to us, that'll help future detection.

aj: agree — long-term ask: require partners to maintain KMS audit forwarding or sign a key-access SLA so we can get near-real-time unwrap alerts. adding to vendor onboarding checklist.

maria: thanks all. I'm collecting evidence and will attach everything to SOM-2026-119. ping me for any blockers. :pray:
